blurb: Guests join guided fishing trips on the Pathfinder 2500 HPS boat with Captain Jeremy Alvarez, an experienced local with 17 years Coast Guard certification and 30 years fishing experience. Trips include inshore fishing for species like redfish, trout, and flounder, offshore fishing for sailfish and grouper, intracoastal fishing, and shark fishing. The operator provides bait, tackle, licenses, cooler, and bottled water, and offers fish cleaning and packaging services.
extraNote: Tipping 15%-20% customary · Contact by email, call or text to book; may be offshore and respond by text · Mayport boat ramp
